entries.title: SEC posts Coinbase Derivatives filing on customer margin requirements for security futures products
entries.facts: On September 23, 2026 the Securities and Exchange Commission placed on Federal Register public inspection, scheduled for publication on September 24, 2026, a notice captioned 'Self-Regulatory Organizations; Coinbase Derivatives, LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Customer Margin Requirements for Security Futures Products' (Release No. 34-106443; File No. SR-COIN-2026-001). The document states that 'CDE is submitting this proposed rule change to establish customer-level margin requirements for security futures that align with current Commission (and CFTC) requirements.' It directs that all submissions refer to file number SR-COIN-2026-001 and be submitted on or before a date that appears in the unpublished document as an unfilled placeholder reading 'INSERT DATE 21 DAYS AFTER DATE OF PUBLICATION IN THE FEDERAL REGISTER'; no calendar date is stated in the document as filed.
entries.source_label: Federal Register public inspection, SEC Release No. 34-106443, File No. SR-COIN-2026-001 (document 2026-19512)
entries.relevant_to: crypto derivatives exchanges, futures commission merchants, security futures intermediaries, clearing firms
